create_openai_client_for_litellm_proxy: create an OpenAI client configured to point at a LiteLLM proxy server with an API key
call_responses_api_with_mcp_tools: call the OpenAI Responses API with MCP tool configuration to use tools across LLM providers
stream_mcp_tool_response: stream the response chunks from an MCP tool call via the Responses API
configure_mcp_server_in_tools: configure an MCP server with a label, URL, and approval setting in the tools parameter
use_mcp_tools_across_llm_providers: use the same MCP tools across all LLM providers through the LiteLLM Proxy MCP Gateway
